_comment: DATA LAYER — single source of truth for MiniGoldenRetrievers pSEO. Edit values here; every generated page reads from this. NEVER hardcode facts into page templates.

primary.label: Golden Cavalier
primary.cross: Golden Retriever x Cavalier King Charles Spaniel

generations.F1: 50% Golden Retriever / 50% Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
generations.F1b: 75% Golden Retriever / 25% Cavalier King Charles Spaniel

breed.RED_LINE: NEVER mention Poodle or Doodle. This breed is NOT crossed with Poodle.

health.note: Hybrid vigor from crossing two diverse gene pools typically means fewer inherited issues than either parent breed.

pricing._note: DYNAMIC — pull live from /mini-golden-retriever-puppies/ when pups available. Fallback to typical range below when sold out.
pricing.sales_tax_note: 6% SC sales tax applies if picking up in South Carolina

delivery.type: flat rate by region, Continental US

breeder.food_guarantee_note: Feed Health Extension or TLC for 3 years to extend 1-Year Health Guarantee to 3 years
breeder.microchip: New unregistered chip; register with National Microchip Registry (nmr.pet), promo code CP for $5 off

process.detail: Fill out an application at /apply/ to show interest and check family fit
$300 refundable deposit (minus 9% processing fee) after approval
Get matched, then pick up at a Partner Home or use delivery
